_comment: The #107 finalists, per PREREGISTRATION.md section 4: the scalarised winners across the lambda sweep, one clearly cheaper, and the incumbent. Efforts and patiences are the eight numbers a configuration is; `scylla` is 0 in every searched finalist because it is absent from all 14 survivors at all three cost weights. `confirm: false` marks a selection that is recorded but not run in the confirmation stage; see its `excluded_because`.

A-fj-only.source: lambda 1/600 selection (simplicity tie-break over 6 survivors); the clearly cheaper arm, total effort 0.16

B-mix-lambda300.source: lambda 1/300 selection (simplicity tie-break over 6 survivors), total effort 10.78

C-mix-lambda1200.source: lambda 1/1200 selection (simplicity tie-break over 2 survivors), total effort 12.06
C-mix-lambda1200.excluded_because: Same suite as B-mix-lambda300 at nearly the same total effort (12.06 vs 10.78), so it is a near-duplicate on the axis the confirmation tests -- it differs only in how that effort splits between the three heuristics. B is kept over it because it has more support (6 surviving configurations at its lambda against C's 2) and less total effort, which is the direction the selection rule's tie-break already prefers. The pre-registration asks for 3-5 finalists spanning cheaper / winner / more generous; A, B and D are exactly that shape, so running C as a fourth was an addition rather than a requirement. Kept here because it is a real search result and the record of what each lambda selected should not be edited to match what was run.

D-shipped.source: the incumbent: #113's measured defaults, shipped in b212155. Not a search output. It is both the baseline every finalist has to beat and the `clearly more generous` arm -- total effort 29.8, and the only finalist running Scylla at all.

E-shipped-plus-fprlp.source: #165's minimum version: D-shipped with fpr_lp enabled at effort 1.0 and nothing else changed. Paired against D-shipped on the identical 20 instances, so the difference between the two arms is fpr_lp and nothing else -- which is exactly the ablation #165 asks for, at the cost of one arm rather than a five-stage campaign. It also answers #165's gating Stage 0 for free: the [Heur] name=fpr_lp phase=dive lines in these logs say how often the dive executes at all, which could not be measured before because the suite token gated presolve FPR and fpr_lp together. The suite is left at the config's own `all`, which names all five tokens; only the effort has to be set, because fpr_lp ships at 0.
